verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer portal lists official SDKs for JavaScript, Java and .NET, alongside build-an-app and API-reference guides, so building against first-party SDKs is a documented capability. The evidence, however, is only a navigation-level listing with no detail on SDK depth or coverage. Missing for 10: SDK documentation depth (installation, auth helpers, API coverage), evidence of SDKs beyond three languages (e.g., Python), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
